newsitem.title: POLAND: Customs strike causes havoc on Polish borders.
newsitem.headline: Customs strike causes havoc on Polish borders.

text.p: A go-slow by Polish customs officers caused huge queues at many of the country's border posts on Tuesday, prompting angered truck drivers to add to the chaos by blocking all access to some crossings.
A federation grouping about half of the 12,500 customs officers have been staging the protest around the clock since early on Monday.
Their chief demand is that bonuses which make up half of their total pay should come from the state budget to ensure that they are always guaranteed rather than discretionary.

A press officer for the Main Customs Office (GUC) told Reuters late on Tuesday that talks were continuing near Warsaw between the office's President Mieczyslaw Nogaj and union chief Andrzej Gajda but she could not say when they might end.
The protest involves meticulously checking every other vehicle or consignment crossing the border rather than one in 10 or fewer which is the usual practice.

Poland's PAP news agency reported that at five crossings, with Germany and the Czech Republic, truck drivers exasperated by delays of many hours were using their vehicles to block access to the border for passenger cars as well.
At Swiecko on the German border, the tail-backs on the German side were stretching for dozens of km (miles).
Polish driver Krzysztof Hajda, interviewed at Swiecko, told public television: "We don't support this strike...it is being carried out at our expense."
But customs officials were sceptical about some of the indignation shown by drivers, saying they were simply scared of proper, thorough customs checks.

"The drivers don't want to lift their canvas or open up their cabs because they are simply afraid of being inspected," officer Wlodzimierz Dworski told the television in Olszyna near the German border.

The work-to-rule was bad luck for 33 Sri Lankan caught crossing into Poland from Ukraine on Monday hidden in a truck carrying wood to Germany and possibly uncovered due to the more meticulous procedures, Gazeta Wyborcza newspaper reported.
The illegal immigrants were turned back to Ukraine.
